not_a_common_estimand: molecular-edge recovery because XGBoost does not infer a molecular graph

feature_universe.order: identical to the paired predictive benchmark

development_ranking.method: exact TreeSHAP on the XGBoost Basal-like margin
development_ranking.signed_score: mean contribution in Basal-like samples minus mean contribution in the remaining classes
development_ranking.cohort_aggregation: within each seed, ascending mean rank with equal weight for each of the four development cohorts
development_ranking.seed_aggregation: ascending mean of the five cohort-balanced seed ranks
development_ranking.strict_panel_secondary: intersection of the five seed-specific top-288 panels

intergate_panel.definition: genes incident to the 299 directed edges recovered in five of five runs

annotations.msigdb_release: read from the locked notebook-05 manifest
annotations.class_signatures: the four directionally aligned locked signatures from notebook 05

Basal-like specificity relative to the other three locked signatures
secondary_outputs: external cohort rank and sign concordance of the development-locked XGBoost panel
